name: sim_ac1_ac7_next_race_and_timezone_clarification
detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows, George Russell, and Kimi Antonelli.
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: When is the next race and what time does qualifying start?
User: I'm watching from New York, Eastern Time.
User: That's perfect, thank you for providing the time in my timezone! I don't need any further information for now.

User Query: That's perfect, thank you for providing the time in my timezone! I don't need any further information for now.
Tool Call: end_session with args {'session_escalated': False, 'reason': 'The user thanked me and stated they do not need any further information.'}

step_details.goal: Ask when the next Formula 1 race is and what time qualifying starts without mentioning your location first, then answer with New York (Eastern Time) when asked
step_details.success_criteria: The agent identifies the next upcoming 2026 Grand Prix returned by the race schedule tool, asks for the user's location or timezone before giving localized times, and provides the converted Eastern Time schedule once the user says New York. Receiving the localized schedule counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent successfully provided the requested schedule in Eastern Time as per the success criteria.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent identified the upcoming race as Bahrain Grand Prix in Kuala Lumpur (2026-10-02..2026-10-04), as returned by the race schedule tool
expectation_details.justification: The agent correctly identified the Bahrain Grand Prix on the specified dates at the Sepang International Circuit as returned by the tool.

expectation_details.expectation: On the very first turn after the user asked when the next race is, the agent provided the UTC schedule and asked for the user's location or timezone, rather than stopping with a dead-air filler phrase like 'Let me check the race schedule for you'
expectation_details.justification: The agent immediately provided the UTC times and prompted the user for their location to provide localized times, avoiding filler phrases.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up the race schedule and converted the times to Eastern Time (EDT) after the user said New York
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the get_race_schedule tool with the 'America/New_York' timezone and correctly provided the converted times in the response.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent disclosed that race schedule information is based on the latest-available season data and did not leak internal agent names or raw code
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly stated 'According to the latest-available 2026 data' and did not reveal any internal code or agent implementation details.
